dedupe_keys.name: thermal rc toolbox grey box rc thermal modelling of buildings with ga identification

description: thermal-rc-toolbox is a Python package for grey-box thermal modelling of buildings with resistance-capacitance networks, with a pipeline that identifies the network parameters from measured data. Identification runs in three stages, optimisation, selection and clustering: a genetic algorithm in Pymoo searches the parameter space within physics-based bounds, the best candidates are selected, and HDBSCAN clustering shows parameter uncertainty and distinct groups of solutions. Built-in models are the 5R1C network of EN ISO 13790 for heat power demand forecasting, an extended 6R3C network for indoor air and supply water temperature, and generic 2R2C and 3R3C networks, and users can register their own. A command line tool runs any range of the stages. Coverage: any building with heating data. Access: free source on GitHub; version 0.1.0 in pyproject; not found on PyPI when checked. Licence: Apache-2.0. Caveats: an early release by one author; results depend on the quality of the measured data and bounds. Simulation uses are fast calibrated building thermal models for control, demand response and heat outage studies inside building or district digital twins. Related records: DarkGreyBox, the Grey Brick calibrated RC models dataset and EnergyPlus.
